name: Pakin Kuna-anuwit
bio:
Mark Pakin Kuna-anuvit is a Thai actor under GMMTV and a former badminton player. He graduated with a bachelor's degree from the Faculty of Political Science at  Bangkokthonburi University and is currently studying for his master's degree.

He made his acting debut in 2021 with a guest role in the series "I Promised You the Moon".

Mark owns the clothing brand Kunagi Studios.

credits.title: Inherit
credits.overview: Follows a wealthy family whose polished exterior begins to crack when an ancient centipede spirit infiltrates their bloodline.
